Recipe 1 (AlGe-CAN): Gel composition 1.5Na₂O:0.5Cs₂O:0.3Al₂O₃:2.4GeO₂:94H₂O. Materials: 0.12 g of NaOH, 0.3 g of CsOH, 0.04 g of Al₂O₃, and 0.25 g of GeO₂ mixed with 1.5 g of deionized water.
Recipe 2 (GaGe-CAN): Gel composition 2.0Na₂O:2.0Cs₂O:1.0Ga₂O₃:3.0GeO₂:60H₂O. Materials: 0.82 g of NaOH, 6.0 g of CsOH, 0.93 g of Ga₂O₃, and 1.56 g of GeO₂ mixed with 2.0 g of deionized water.
extracted text:
AlGe-CAN synthesis: The mixture was stirred for 24 h at room temperature, then heated in a sealed Teflon lined stainless steel autoclave at 170°C for 24 h.

GaGe-CAN synthesis: The mixture was stirred for 24 h at room temperature, then heated in a sealed Teflon lined stainless steel autoclave at 110°C for five days.

Both products were filtered, washed with deionized water, and dried at room temperature.

formula abbreviations:
AlGe-CAN: Na₆Cs₂Al₆Ge₆O₂₄·Ge(OH)₆ - Aluminogermanate with cancrinite framework topology
GaGe-CAN: Na₆Cs₂Ga₆Ge₆O₂₄·Ge(OH)₆ - Gallogermanate with cancrinite framework topology
Na₂O represents sodium oxide from NaOH
Cs₂O represents cesium oxide from CsOH
Al₂O₃ represents aluminum oxide
Ga₂O₃ represents gallium oxide
GeO₂ represents germanium oxide
